## NSXL for Windows 1.4.0

**A seamless quick menu**
- Opening the quick menu now blurs your actual screen in place. NSXL takes a full-resolution picture of the screen and shows it pixel-for-pixel. It then dissolves into the blurred, dimmed backdrop as the dock and cards slide in. There's no jump from sharp to blurry.
- Closing plays the same thing in reverse before the menu goes away. That's the case however it closes: B, the buttons again, or switching to a game.
- No more rounded corners or thin white outline around the menu. Windows' window corners, border and pop-in animation are turned off for it, so it sits flush with the screen edges.
- The menu only appears once its first frame is ready, so the previous backdrop can't flash up.
